attributes.scope: symbol-adoption pass (work_claim.symbol-adoption.20260831.v1) resolving the 2026-08-30 symaudit exact-gap/spelling candidates for this TU; verified via fnasm+source read+caller context per AGENTS.md symbol-naming procedure, then adopted through the cross-TU rename law and gated with a full ninja build + fndiff spot-check

adopted.evidence: Per-frame animation-timeline effect dispatcher (row/t0/t1 window test) that, on entering a hit window, sets Effects[mode].damage/mindp/damageradius/damagetype/damagedelay via its sub-helper and dispatches SetSkinFX/hit-audio; called from pmotion.c during player grab/attack animation processing. Already carried a live attempt record (attempt.fn-80089350-portable-closure.20260829.v1, outcome improved) whose function anchor was repointed to the new name as part of this pass' graph repair (see the pass attempt record).

Called twice from PlyrSfxDoDamage (formerly fn_80089350) to spawn one player effect from a sequence row; body sets Effects[mode].damage/mindp/damageradius/damagetype/damagedelay directly (confirms the 'damage' concept) and is architecturally the Sub-helper of PlyrSfxDoDamage, matching the Do*/Do*Sub naming pair already used elsewhere in this TU (DoPlyrSfxSub/DoPlyrSfx).

value.naming_notes: Both exact-gap candidates adopted; the one spelling-mismatch candidate was rejected on direct body-content evidence.

rejected.reason: The current name is not a placeholder: the function carries an existing verified provenance comment ('Xbox PDB: DoPlyrSfxSub') from a prior session, and its body (record dispatch: SetSkinFX/PsfxDoParticle/DoPlyrSfx/ShakeCamera/SafeRockSetup + recursion through record->_04) is a record-processing dispatcher, not a velocity calculation -- 'CalcPlayerSfxVel' does not match observed behavior. Treated as a stale positional collision with an already-correctly-named neighbor; current name retained.
